title: Home practical guide and safety card: energy changes
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 33 (Home practical guide and safety card: energy changes (portal worksheet; adult handles steel wool, plastic cups only))
intro: Lesson 33: Home thermometer practical: energy changes. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To measure temperature changes in reactions
safety: Adult handles steel wool, plastic cups only
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put 50 ml of vinegar in a plastic cup wrapped in a towel
Add one spoon of bicarbonate of soda; stir
An adult places damp steel wool round the thermometer in a cup; record the temperature after 5 minutes
Decide which change is exothermic and which endothermic

questions.q: Insulating the cup makes results more...
Big question: metal or polystyrene cup: which shows the bigger drop?
questions.a: Polystyrene: it insulates, so less energy flows in.
